description: Match a cat description to likely breeds from furriq.com's curated database of 61 breeds. Describe what the cat looks like or how it behaves (coat pattern, body shape, ears, temperament) and get the top candidates with the specific markers that matched. Deterministic — no AI guessing.

description.description: Description of the cat, e.g. "large fluffy cat with a bushy tail and lynx-like ear tufts" or "small hairless wrinkly cat".

name: find_cat_breed
